challenges.title: Implement Shell Prompt Function
challenges.description: Before a shell can accept user commands, it must signal to the user that it is ready by displaying a visible prompt.
challenges.task: Write a Function named PrintPrompt that writes a standard prompt string (like '$ ') to standard output and flushes the writer.
hints: Use os.Stdout as your output target.
Remember to ensure the output is flushed if using a buffered writer.

challenges.title: Read User Input Line
challenges.description: A shell must read input lines interactively from the user to process commands correctly.
challenges.task: Write a Function that takes an io.Reader and returns the next line of input as a string using bufio.Scanner.
hints: Call scanner.Scan() to advance the scanner.

challenges.title: Handle Exit and EOF Gracefully
challenges.description: A robust REPL must handle both explicit exit commands and stream closures gracefully to avoid infinite loops.
challenges.task: Write a code snippet using a bufio.Scanner that reads lines from os.Stdin, checks if the input is equal to 'exit' or if scanner.Scan() returns false, and breaks the loop.
hints: Use the boolean return value of scanner.Scan() to detect EOF.
